selection_before_predictions: All five purple 24 degC measured markers in Figure 22, top-right 0 wt% NaCl panel; no curve interpolation or post-prediction point selection

extraction.marker_rule: dense purple connected components, RGB B>R+10, R>G+20, B>G+45, R<170; exclude legend and tiny dotted-line components; visually checked against complete figure
extraction.display_precision: pressure 0.01 bar, solubility 0.001 g/kg are digitization outputs, not measurement precision
extraction.digitization_bounds: 0.5 bar and 0.03 g/kg conservative extraction bounds, separate from experimental uncertainty

conditions.initial_recipe: degassed deionised water, no added NaCl; modeled as pure water, trace contaminants not independently quantified
conditions.gas_boundary: CO2 bottle pressure regulated; model fixed partial pressure with nonexhausted numerical CO2 reservoir
conditions.equilibrium_criterion: impedance change less than 1% for 12 h, consistency aliquots subsequently sampled
conditions.Ca_method: EDTA titration, mean of five analyses; total dissolved Ca expressed as CaCO3, not free ion activity
conditions.reported_general_analytical_uncertainty: usually below 1%; per-point uncertainty/confidence level not given
conditions.figure_mass_basis: g/kg in axis, solvent versus final solution not explicit; both model normalizations must be reported

predeclared_model.aqueous_activity: database ion-association/extended Debye-Huckel profile; no experimental parameter tuning
predeclared_model.gas_EOS: native PHREEQC Peng-Robinson via CO2(g) fixed partial pressure; no substitution of partial pressure by fugacity
predeclared_model.solution_pressure_bar: pCO2 + 0.03 bar, declared approximate 24C water-vapor correction; not an observed absolute-pressure value
predeclared_model.comparison: signed and relative CaCO3-equivalent endpoint errors for both kg-water and kg-final-solution bases; do not infer a validated path, rate, pH error or independent solid mass gain from Ca alone
predeclared_model.acceptance: Report quantitative disagreement as well as agreement. This is a bounded digitized endpoint challenge; exact run reconstruction remains limited by mass-basis and per-run-stock metadata.
